title: Apply A Tracked Change Plus A Comment In One Patch
task: Create an edited output document in the run directory using docxedit only.
In one patch, make a small guarded visible text replacement and add a review comment anchored to the same paragraph.
Use replace-text with expect-text and apply with --track-changes require, --author "DocxEdit Challenge", and --timestamp-utc "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z".
Run docxedit check before apply. If check fails, recover using only docxedit inspection commands and help.
Validate the output with docxedit read, docxedit changes with comment text included, and docxedit validate.
successCriteria: Uses one patch with replace-text, expect-text, and add-comment under --track-changes require.
Produces an output .docx with a new inserted-run/deleted-run pair and a new comment.
Does not quote private text in the final response.
observerQuestions: Did the agent express the text change plus comment as one atomic patch?
Did require-mode handling of the annotation operation feel predictable?
Could the agent verify both halves from docxedit output alone?
